svg.text: ihp-sg13g2: tri-state pads -- turning on into 100 pF, floating (ngspice)
TriOut16mA: output enable rising, pin from float to 1
TriOut16mA: output enable rising, pin from float to 0
TriOut16mA: output enable falling, the pin at 1 lets go
V at the pin (100 pF, 2 kohm to the other rail)
TriOut16mA: output enable falling, the pin at 0 lets go
V at the pin (100 pF, 2 kohm to the other rail)
TriOut16mA: the driver's current as it lets go of 1
TriOut16mA: the driver's current as it lets go of 0
